raw:
Agent Name: Planner
, Step Number: 5
, Reason for Mistake: The Planner misidentified the overlapping screenwriter. The sources correctly showed Evolution credited to David Diamond, David Weissman, and Don Jakoby (story), and The Family Man credited to David Diamond and David Weissman. The Planner erroneously concluded the common writer was Don Jakoby, who did not co-write The Family Man, instead of identifying David Diamond (and/or David Weissman) as the correct overlap.
